name: Paul Mazza's Fruit and Vegetable Stand
description: Paul Mazza's Fruit and Vegetable Stand grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Peaches, and Pumpkins in Colchester, VT. The farm is working, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
